verdict.rationale: Loops documents a visual email editor with brand-consistent styling (colors/type/spacing applied automatically) and transactional emails with dynamic data/personalization variables, plus campaign creation via editor or Content API/LMX. Community evidence confirms the editor is built on extended MJML (a format designed for cross-client compatibility), lending some credibility to rendering reliability, but there's no explicit documentation or test evidence of cross-email-client rendering QA or a dedicated reusable-template library feature. Missing for 10: explicit cross-client rendering guarantees/testing evidence, and clearer documentation of a reusable template gallery beyond ad-hoc campaign/content authoring.
